title: SpongeBob Theme Song
blurb: "Are you ready, kids?" More than two decades on, the SpongeBob theme remains one of the most efficient pieces of children's television ever written: a sea-shanty call-and-response that teaches you the words on the first listen and then never, ever leaves. Series creator Stephen Hillenburg had a hand in writing it, and its cheerful pirate energy set the tone for everything that followed. Play it in a room of adults and watch every one of them answer "Aye aye, Captain!" without being asked.
origin: The opening theme of SpongeBob SquarePants (Nickelodeon, 1999).
